name: robotics-signal-scope
description: 模拟机械关节信号波形遥测控制台
interaction: A retro-industrial telemetry console simulates real-time joint signals from a robotic arm. Users manipulate multi-axis sliders and toggle signal channels (position, velocity, torque) while a live oscilloscope renders the corresponding waveforms with CRT-style glow and scan artifacts. Triggering
modes distorts the waveform in real time, accompanied by mechanical vibration feedback and system status alerts.
